scientific_integrity: Analytically derived fixed-level boundary expansion. Self-review only; no independent audit or external validation.
scientific_limitations: The expansion is pointwise for each fixed significance level, dimension, and deterministic weight vector.
The theorem does not establish an all-level global stochastic order at any fixed correlation below one.
Quadrature is supplementary; correctness rests on analytic Gaussian truncation and Taylor estimates.
Published priority remains subject to independent bibliographic verification.
title: Gaussian near-comonotonic inflation of harmonic-mean p-values
